title: For instances in availability zone flare3 running on host
question: For instances in availability zone flare3 running on host blaze8-12 whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count for that same host and availability zone, list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, extra flavor JSON, system metadata key/value, and the row number within each metadata key group (ordered by instance UUID), along with the availability zone’s maximum geometric mean instance memory (MB) for host blaze8-12 (non-deleted instances with system metadata), and compute a normalized memory ratio (instance memory divided by that zone geometric-mean memory).

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor AS extra_flavor
  FROM instances i
  LEFT JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
),
avg_vcpu AS (
  SELECT AVG(vcpus) AS avg_v
  FROM base
),
zone_gm AS (
  SELECT MAX(EXP(AVG(LN(memory_mb)))) AS zone_gm_mem
  FROM base
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata sm
    WHERE sm.instance_uuid = base.uuid
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    b.uuid,
    b.display_name,
    b.memory_mb,
    b.vcpus,
    b.extra_flavor,
    sm.key AS sys_meta_key,
    sm.value AS sys_meta_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.key ORDER BY b.uuid) AS rn
  FROM base b
  CROSS JOIN avg_vcpu av
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON b.uuid = sm.instance_uuid
  WHERE b.vcpus > av.avg_v
)
SELECT
  r.uuid,
  r.display_name,
  r.memory_mb,
  r.vcpus,
  r.extra_flavor,
  r.sys_meta_key,
  r.sys_meta_value,
  r.rn,
  zg.zone_gm_mem,
  r.memory_mb / zg.zone_gm_mem AS normalized_memory_ratio
FROM ranked r
CROSS JOIN zone_gm zg
ORDER BY r.sys_meta_key, r.uuid
